content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where Stripe and PayPal are restricted, digital creators face significant challenges in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-now[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-trap-most-creators-3|The Payment]]s-webhooks-cloudflare-workers-step-step-16|setting]] up online stores that can accept payments and deliver products seamlessly. This infrastructure gap can be bridged with the right tools and knowledge, allowing creators to deploy their own digital stores on platforms like Cloudflare Pages for free, without relying on conventional payment gateways.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The combination of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments provides a robust and scalable infrastructure for digital stores. This stack is particularly useful for creators who cannot access traditional payment platforms, as it enables them to accept crypto payments with minimal fees and no KYC requirements. By [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/deploying-digital-store-cloudflare-pages-free-everything-you-15|COREMERCH guide to deploying]] this infrastructure, creators can ensure that their stores are always available and can process transactions securely and efficiently.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you need to have a clear understanding of your products, target audience, and marketing strategy. You also need to choose the right stack for your needs, whether it's Stack 01, which can be deployed in 4-6 hours following the Sovereign Blueprint, or Stack 02, which is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Additionally, you need to set up your payment and delivery pipeline, including configuring NOWPayments and integrating it with your store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves configuring NOWPayments to accept crypto payments and integrating it with your store. You also need to set up a delivery mechanism, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to ensure that products are delivered to customers instantly after payment confirmation. This pipeline is critical to the success of your digital store, as it enables you to process transactions securely and efficiently, and deliver products to customers without delays or losses.

Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have deployed your store and set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live and start processing transactions. This involves testing your store to ensure that it is working as expected, and configuring analytics to track sales and customer behavior. You also need to promote your store to attract customers and drive sales, using marketing strategies such as social media advertising, email marketing, and content marketing. With the right infrastructure and marketing strategy, you can process your first transaction and start generating revenue from your digital store.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is up and running, you can scale it to reach more customers and increase revenue. This involves optimizing your store for performance, security, and user experience, and configuring analytics to track sales and customer behavior. You also need to expand your product offerings and marketing strategies to attract new customers and retain existing ones, using tactics such as upselling, cross-selling, and loyalty programs. With the right infrastructure and scaling strategy, you can grow your digital store into a successful and sustainable business.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you need to deploy a stack that includes a hosting platform like Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic platform like Workers, a database like Supabase, and a payment gateway like NOWPayments. This stack provides a robust and scalable infrastructure for digital stores, enabling you to accept crypto payments with minimal fees and no KYC requirements, and deliver products instantly after payment confirmation.

To deploy a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, you need to set up a Cloudflare account, create a new page, and configure your domain settings. You also need to deploy your store using a stack that includes Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, and configure your payment and delivery pipeline. Additionally, you need to test your store to ensure that it is working as expected, and configure analytics to track sales and customer behavior. Finally, you need to promote your store to attract customers and drive sales, using marketing strategies such as social media advertising, email marketing, and content marketing.
